profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, TSMC, describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. The company operates a foundry business model supporting global customers and partners, and states it offers the industry's leading process technology along with design enablement solutions. According to its website, TSMC focuses on accelerating innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, with the aim of advancing IC pervasiveness across modern technologies.

TSMC is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, with ticker symbol TSM. The held facts show no products currently tracked, no litigation cases, and no MCP server registry presence in the reference site's records.
